title: Platform Fee Calculation Flow
purpose: Trace the 12.5% platform fee from the hardcoded DEFAULT_COMMISSION_RATE constant through per-transaction calculation, DB storage, implicit treasury accumulation, and eventual aggregated payout
description: The platform fee flow begins at lib/constants.ts which defines DEFAULT_COMMISSION_RATE = 12.5. When verifyAndRecordBasePayment processes a transaction, it calculates platformFee = Math.round(amount * 12.5 / 100) and creatorPayout = amount - platformFee. Both values are stored in the transactions table columns platform_fee and creator_payout. The platform treasury is implicit — there is no separate treasury table; fees are accumulated in transaction data. Creator payouts are aggregated from creator_payout across transactions. Two override mechanisms exist but are NOT implemented: (1) Enclave 10% override (enclave_applications.status column exists but no fee logic uses it), (2) Per-creator commission override (profiles.commission_rate is nullable and unused).

businessRules.rule: Default platform fee = 12.5% of payment amount
Enclave member fee = 10% (logic NOT yet implemented — code path does not exist)
Per-creator commission_rate column exists but is unused in fee calculation
No separate treasury table — fees tracked implicitly via platform_fee column on transactions

securityConsiderations: Fee rate (12.5%) is hardcoded — env var override would be more secure and configurable
Tiered fee calculation defaults to 15% on DB error — potential overcharging until corrected
Enclave override not implemented — Enclave members charged full fee despite promise of 10% discount
Unused commission_rate column could cause confusion if filled but never applied
performanceConsiderations: Fee calculation is a simple Math.round operation — negligible CPU cost
Tiered fee requires current-month transaction aggregation query — adds DB load per payment
Treasury aggregation queries all transactions for SUM — potential slow query for large datasets

annotations.text: Enclave 10% override is NOT IMPLEMENTED — enclave_applications.status exists but no fee logic branches on it
Per-creator commission_rate column is nullable and unused — no custom commission logic exists
Platform treasury is implicit — no separate treasury table, fees are aggregated from transaction records
Fee calculation uses Math.round for integer cent precision — no floating point issues
Tiered fee (fee.utils.ts) uses monthly earnings brackets: ≤$5k=15%, $5k-$10k=12.5%, >$10k=10%
